learning_outcomes.text: Prospective teachers can select appropriate texts for Turkish lessons.
They can write a critical essay on the selected texts.
They can fill the concept of literature teaching with theoretical and practical dimensions.
They can prepare creative works with qualified texts prepared for children, the target audience of Turkish lessons.

syllabus_topics: Determining the objectives of the course and planning activities for the semester
